owner: HAND protocol 2 boundary mapping; event and page values come from ORIGINAL
G1_private_page: Remove only HTTP adapter display, patch, find and images; retain every private page field.
G1_native: Use ORIGINAL native line events and fixture byte spans inside protocol 2 start_byte/end_byte/lines envelopes.
G1_follow: Use binding pi-live-binding, explicit read_end_byte and complete_end_byte from the scheduled input bytes, and terminated=true for complete lines. A partial line advances read_end_byte only.
G1_fault: Map OLD public failure status to the caller's Fault::Core. A cancelled PageJob returns Fault::Cancelled by its API contract.
G2_G3: No hand-edited expected fields. Compare whole public objects, including images maps. Exclude ping heartbeat frames only.
schedule: For SSE follow after byte 1687, append one complete fixture line, then drain both reader pairs before the next line. Preserve all frames at each step.
